hash_pyarrow_table: compute an xxHash digest of a PyArrow table including its schema and all column data buffers
add_metadata_to_table: attach a dictionary of metadata to a PyArrow table schema, preserving previous metadata
explode_table_with_max_length: unroll list columns in a PyArrow table into smaller lists capped at a fixed max sequence length
apply_over_groups: apply a mapping function to each group of a PyArrow table grouped by specified columns
hstack_pyarray_list: horizontally stack multiple PyArrow list arrays element-wise into a single combined list array
